vote_contract.linear_arm: Each lens allocates 100 ordinary credits over its twelve highest-utility non-owned hypotheses by Hamilton apportionment.
vote_contract.quadratic_arm: Each lens allocates exactly 100 credits over non-owned hypotheses; v vote units cost v^2; an exact dynamic program maximizes the same declared utility surface.
vote_contract.utility_surface: Declared candidate qualities, each lens's two criterion priorities, bounded tag affinity, bounded community proximity, and a small cross-family bonus.
vote_contract.social_distance: Shortest-path distance between nine declared disciplinary communities. Bridge score combines quadratic support, owner-supporter distance, and community breadth; it is not evidence or an automatic winner rule.

hypotheses.title: Common-View Fixed-Point Law
hypotheses.statement: A physical interaction network selects the least stable fixed point at which its record, admissible-action, composition, finality, and comparison maps become mutually closed under every lawful continuation.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Exhibit one frozen physical process with two inequivalent stable closures, or derive a unique closure without target fitting.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: distributed fixed-point semantics and bisimulation

hypotheses.title: Causal-Gossip View-Selection Law
hypotheses.statement: The transitive signed event DAG of a closed interaction process uniquely selects the common-view family through ancestry, famous-witness-style agreement, and invariant causal provenance.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Hold the complete DAG fixed and vary admissible view families; uniqueness wins and any inequivalent survivor kills the claim.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: event structures, Lamport order, and Hashgraph representation

hypotheses.title: Metastable Evidence-Closure Law
hypotheses.statement: Matched views become physical when repeated independent local response sampling crosses a provenance-adjusted metastability threshold, with hysteresis separating formation from erasure.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Derive and test a threshold invariant under representation and common-shock controls; smooth ordinary decoherence kills the excess claim.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: metastability, percolation, and decoherence

hypotheses.title: Typed Quorum Actuality Law
hypotheses.statement: A distinction becomes safely action-enabling exactly when a physically defined adversary class makes its provenance certificate intersect every incompatible lawful continuation in a quorum.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Specify the physical adversary and prove quorum intersection; an equally lawful conflicting continuation after certification kills it.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: BFT quorum-intersection theorems

hypotheses.title: Monotone Actuality-Join Law
hypotheses.statement: Public classical facts are the least join-closed monotone substructure of local formed records, and nonclassicality is precisely the failure of candidate merges to be monotone and confluent.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Construct the physical join and show order-independent convergence; contextual or reversible records that falsely pass the join test kill it.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: CRDT/CALM and categorical classical structures

hypotheses.title: Global-History Serializability Criterion
hypotheses.statement: A global physical history exists for an admitted record network if and only if every physically executable local transaction history admits one gauge-respecting common serialization.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Find a finite record network whose intervention statistics agree locally but whose serialization verdict disagrees with global-history existence.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: contextuality, consistent histories, and database serializability

hypotheses.title: Provenance-Closed Record Law
hypotheses.statement: The physically selected record of an occurrence is the minimal append-only causal lineage sufficient to reproduce every admissible downstream response while forbidding source-substituted twins.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Use history twins and source swaps to test whether one minimal lineage is physically selected rather than analyst-chosen.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: event sourcing, process tensors, and sufficient statistics

hypotheses.title: Proof-Carrying Actuality Law
hypotheses.statement: A shared physical fact is a locally retained commitment plus a composable proof that every admitted rival completion violates the same physical response constraints, without requiring disclosure of the completing history.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Build a physical verification map and show zero-knowledge separation between certification and disclosure; imported trusted setup kills physical selection.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: interactive proofs, hypothesis testing, and quantum verification

hypotheses.title: Threshold-Opening Formation Law
hypotheses.statement: A latent relational distinction becomes publicly actual only when a physically selected access structure combines enough independent shares to open one irreversible, provenance-bearing record.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Identify naturally formed shares and threshold; an arbitrary partition or ordinary coarse graining absorbs the proposal.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: secret sharing, superselection, and measurement amplification

hypotheses.title: Private-State Public-Capability Law
hypotheses.statement: Physics can select a common actionable reality from relational response proofs even when no observer or region reconstructs the underlying local state, so shared capability is more fundamental operationally than shared disclosure.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Hold public responses fixed while varying hidden states and test no-refit capability transfer; ordinary operational equivalence absorbs a null.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: MPC, operational theories, and zero-knowledge

hypotheses.title: Authenticated Rate-Distortion Ruler Law
hypotheses.statement: The physically available metric between states or regions is the minimum authenticated communication cost required to preserve every admitted action outcome within a fixed distortion tolerance.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Derive a target-independent distortion measure and compare it with an independently calibrated physical metric; task-fitted distortion kills it.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: rate-distortion geometry and information geometry

hypotheses.title: Minimal Stable Sufficient Representation Law
hypotheses.statement: Fundamental dynamics selects the coarsest dynamically invariant state quotient sufficient for every physically realizable continuation, and the matched views are its canonical projections and consumers.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Prove uniqueness up to physical gauge for a source-pinned process; two incomparable sufficient stable quotients kill the law.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: minimal realization, causal states, Petz sufficiency, and predictive state representations

hypotheses.title: Joint-Observability Closure Law
hypotheses.statement: The physically selected view family is the minimal intervention-and-readout family whose joint observability operator has full rank on lawful states modulo physical gauge, while ruler responses are its calibrated active probes.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Compute the minimal family before the held-out target; multiple non-equivalent minimal realizations or unphysical controls kill uniqueness.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: system identification and observability theory

hypotheses.title: Parametric View-Coherence Law
hypotheses.statement: A physical common-view family is the unique gauge-natural refinement system whose maps commute with every lawful process morphism and cannot inspect the target representation.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Prove a naturality/parametricity theorem or return a no-section counterexample under the full automorphism group.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: parametricity, descent, and natural-transformation no-go theorems

hypotheses.title: Regional Predict-Reconcile Law
hypotheses.statement: Local observer realities are authoritative only within finite causal-interest regions, while cross-region interactions select shared facts by deterministic reconciliation of provenance-bearing state deltas rather than by one global view.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Construct a relativistically admissible regional protocol with no hidden global authority and derive a novel invariant or exact obstruction.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: distributed simulation, relational QM, and causal networks

hypotheses.title: Cross-Shard Physical Gluing Law
hypotheses.statement: Nature selects local record-and-capability quotients per causally bounded shard, and global geometry is the obstruction-sensitive result of atomic gluing across their overlap interfaces.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Show local selector uniqueness plus path-independent gluing, or measure the holonomy/obstruction left by merger order.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: sheaf descent, lattice gauge theory, and atomic commit

hypotheses.title: Predictive-Bottleneck Formation Law
hypotheses.statement: Stable physical records are dynamically selected bottlenecks that minimize retained state subject to preserving the distribution of every attainable future interaction.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Derive the bottleneck objective from physics rather than training choice and distinguish its selected representation from alternate equally predictive encodings.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: information bottleneck, predictive coding, and causal states

hypotheses.title: Physical Causal-State Law
hypotheses.statement: Histories belong to one physical state exactly when they induce the same conditional distribution over every admissible future intervention, and dynamics selects the resulting epsilon-machine as the observer-relative ontology.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Freeze all interventions and prove closure/uniqueness; an inaccessible intervention that splits one causal state reveals the supplied action boundary.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: computational mechanics and predictive-state representations

hypotheses.title: Logical-Code Shared-Reality Law
hypotheses.statement: Public records are the logical observables of the dynamically selected maximal correctable algebra, regional access is decoder-relative, and ruler responses are syndrome-sensitive logical probes.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Derive the code and decoder-access class from one source dynamics; multiple maximal correctable algebras or supplied decoders kill selection.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: operator quantum error correction and holographic codes

hypotheses.title: Irreducible Closure Boundary Law
hypotheses.statement: The physically meaningful views are exactly the invariants computable within a region's resource horizon without replaying the complete irreducible transition history, and finality marks the boundary where recomputation is no longer operationally available.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Define the resource class covariantly and exhibit a scaling separation; model-dependent complexity assumptions or mere practical hardness kill it.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: logical depth, complexity theory, and thermodynamic resource theories

hypotheses.title: Action-Selected Pointer-Algebra Law
hypotheses.statement: For a complete system-apparatus-environment action, the stable pointer algebra is the unique maximal subalgebra invariant under the reduced dynamics and physically readable by the same interaction that writes it.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Derive writer, stable algebra, and reader jointly; degeneracy under equally physical apparatus splittings kills uniqueness.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: decoherence, instrument theory, and open-system fixed algebras

hypotheses.title: Redundant-Accessibility Phase Law
hypotheses.statement: A record becomes regionally public at a universal transition in independently accessible redundant environmental support, and that transition simultaneously changes the safe action algebra.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Freeze fragment accessibility and test finite-size scaling plus action change; ordinary SBS without a sharp transition absorbs it.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: Quantum Darwinism, spectrum broadcast structure, and percolation

hypotheses.title: Modular Response-Closure Law
hypotheses.statement: A state, local algebra net, and dynamics select the observer-relative record, access, and ruler structures as the smallest modularly invariant response subnetwork on which relative entropy and causal propagation close.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Specify the inclusion and prove canonical closure under all physical automorphisms; multiple modularly natural subnetworks or missing apparatus semantics kill it.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: modular theory, sufficiency, and AQFT inclusions

hypotheses.title: Recoverable-Algebra Sufficiency Law
hypotheses.statement: The common-view family is the unique maximal algebra exactly recoverable from every admitted observer channel while retaining all held-out intervention statistics.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Use Petz/correctable-algebra criteria on one physical channel family; nonunique maximal algebras or channel refit kills the claim.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: Petz recovery and operator quantum error correction

hypotheses.title: Relational Descent Law
hypotheses.statement: Physical views are local gauge-fixed sections of one relational response object, and admissible perspective changes uniquely select their matched descent data while leaving only gauge-invariant holonomy as global remainder.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Construct the perspective groupoid and test descent; unmatched sections or physically measurable gauge-choice dependence kill it.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: quantum reference frames, gauge theory, and sheaf descent

hypotheses.title: Instrument Fixed-Point Selection Law
hypotheses.statement: Repeated lawful system-apparatus interaction selects the unique extremal instrument fixed point whose classical output algebra is stable under composition and whose dilation supplies its material consumer.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Solve the instrument fixed points and retain all dilation freedoms; nonunique extremal fixed points or consumer dependence kills selection.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: quantum instruments, dilation theory, and quantum Markov chains

hypotheses.title: Metastable Lindbladian Record Law
hypotheses.statement: A complete local Lindbladian selects long-lived record sectors, admissible transitions, and regional finality through an isolated slow spectral subspace, with the same spectrum fixing retention and readout timescales.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Derive the spectral sector and test robustness under allowed perturbations; arbitrary coarse graining or multiple inequivalent slow algebras kills it.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: metastability, noiseless subsystems, and open-system spectral theory

hypotheses.title: Dissipative Stability Selection Law
hypotheses.statement: Among compatible view families, physical dynamics selects those minimizing excess entropy production while remaining stable and compositionally sufficient under the admitted driving protocol.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Derive the variational principle and protocol-independent minimizer; externally chosen coarse graining or near-equilibrium absorption kills it.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: minimum entropy production and stochastic thermodynamics

hypotheses.title: Stopping-Time Finality Law
hypotheses.statement: A record becomes final for an observer when its likelihood-ratio process reaches a physically selected absorbing stopping boundary after which every admissible continuation preserves the action decision within the declared error.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Derive the boundary from dynamics and resources; an analyst-selected confidence threshold or reopening continuation kills it.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: sequential analysis, martingales, and quantum trajectories

hypotheses.title: Interventional Causal-State Selector
hypotheses.statement: One physical action family selects the coarsest history quotient invariant under all interventions, and records, capabilities, provenance, and geometry are matched statistics of that causal quotient.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Freeze a realizable intervention family and prove quotient sufficiency plus no-refit transfer; changing the action menu changes the answer and exposes the supplied observer boundary.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: causal inference, process tensors, and sufficient statistics

hypotheses.title: Regional Common-View Sheaf Law
hypotheses.statement: No unique global view family is selected; dynamics selects compatible local response closures whose gluing class determines public facts and whose nontrivial holonomy is the finite physical remainder.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Build the typed sheaf from one physical process and predict an order/topology-dependent invariant; arbitrary cover choice or vanishing after standard gauge reduction kills it.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: sheaf contextuality, gauge holonomy, and descent theory

hypotheses.title: Universal Natural-Closure Law
hypotheses.statement: The selected matched view family is the universal fixed object of a physically defined closure functor from processes to record-action-ruler diagrams, unique up to natural isomorphism.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Define the functor without inserting the desired views and prove universality; two nonisomorphic universal candidates or no physical functor kills it.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: category theory, adjunctions, and coalgebraic semantics

hypotheses.title: Principal-Symbol Ruler-Closure Law
hypotheses.statement: For a well-posed local field theory, the principal symbol selects causal propagation and conformal geometry, while a dynamically selected calibrated response functional supplies the remaining scale and completes the ruler family.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Derive both symbol and scale response from one action; scale refit or multiple admissible calibrators kills metric selection.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: hyperbolic inverse problems and causal/metric reconstruction

hypotheses.title: Hyperbolic Symmetrizer Selection Law
hypotheses.statement: The physically realized common views are the unique positive-energy variables selected by a covariant symmetrizer that makes the response equations hyperbolic, stable, and compositionally transmissible.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Prove symmetrizer uniqueness and show its variables coincide with formed/read records; nonunique symmetrizers or no record semantics kills it.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: symmetric-hyperbolic PDE theory and energy estimates

hypotheses.title: Covariant Action-Response Closure Law
hypotheses.statement: A complete covariant action selects, through its stationary solution, Hessian, constraints, and response spectrum, one gauge orbit of matched records, admissible actions, composition rules, regional finality, and calibrated ruler responses.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Hold the action and boundary data fixed and compute every residual automorphism; any two inequivalent matched view/ruler families kill uniqueness.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: variational physics, spectral geometry, decoherence, and inverse problems

hypotheses.title: Pairwise Response-Kernel Law
hypotheses.statement: The fundamental selector is not a field state but the covariant pairwise source-response kernel; records, capabilities, and rulers are the minimal invariant factorizations through which all physically realizable pair interactions compose.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Formulate the kernel without a field mediator and test whether its invariant factorization uniquely reconstructs the observed local field description.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: direct-action electrodynamics, S-matrix reconstruction, and mediator elimination

hypotheses.title: RG-Stable Observable-Closure Law
hypotheses.statement: The physical common-view family is the maximal observable-and-response subalgebra stable under renormalization across the admitted scale interval, with classical records and rulers as robust infrared coordinates.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Run the exact coarse-graining map and test uniqueness/no-refit transfer; scheme dependence or several inequivalent stable algebras kills selection.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: effective field theory and renormalization

hypotheses.title: Order-Volume-Ruler Reconstruction Law
hypotheses.statement: A physically selected causal order, event-volume measure, and finite calibration mark jointly determine the regional geometry, while record and capability views are the observer-accessible restrictions of that ordered measure space.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Prove reconstruction in a finite causal arena and test scale transfer; a supplied sprinkling density or calibration mark leaves the key selector open.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: causal-set reconstruction and Lorentzian geometry

hypotheses.title: Generalized-Symmetry Record-Net Law
hypotheses.statement: A complete gauge action selects a net of defect and Wilson observables whose superselection, fusion, and screening structure jointly fixes composable records, allowed capabilities, regional gluing, and ruler response.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Derive the net and its physical reader from one action; matter-dependent screening or multiple probe choices that alter the net kill uniqueness.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: generalized symmetries, algebraic QFT, and lattice gauge theory

hypotheses.title: Regional Plurality Obstruction
hypotheses.statement: No target-blind law can select one globally privileged common-view family; the strongest lawful result is a regional equivalence class indexed by physical action boundaries, with exact translation maps and a measurable first gluing failure.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Prove a no-section theorem for global selection while constructing regional translations; one canonical global selector refutes it.
hypotheses.strongest_absorber: contextuality, model theory, and observer-relative operational equivalence
